description: Read-only device info. Android: model, SDK, ABIs, locale, screen, orientation (listPackages:true adds third-party packages; logs:{…} captures filtered logcat). iOS Simulator: name, runtime, state, screen.

logs.description: Android: save logcat to an artifact instead. Scans the last `lines` (1000) lines overall; level is the minimum; package also matches a crashed app (its `Process:` PID); grep is a regex, context = lines kept after each match (40 shows a FATAL stack; or use buffer:"crash"); since = "5m" / "90s" / "MM-DD hh:mm:ss".

packageFilter.description: Substring filter for the package list.
